one_line: Young Kashmiri-Timurid prince and future Sultan, sharpened by Samarkand’s culture and hard Kashmiri politics.

appearance.age_look: Early twenties, lean athletic build, slightly taller than average with a poised, disciplined stance.
appearance.face: Oval face, light brown Kashmiri-Timurid complexion, straight nose, sharp brows, faint scar along left cheek, calm yet calculating gaze with a default expression of composed focus and subtle determination.
appearance.hair: Thick straight black hair, medium length, brushed back from the forehead and tied low at the nape with a narrow dark-red cloth band, partly covered by a simple dark indigo Kashmiri-Timurid turban wound low and firm without ornament.
appearance.costume: He wears a long Kashmiri-Timurid style jama-like robe of matte deep forest green wool, fitted at the torso and flaring at mid-calf, fastened slightly to the right with a row of small brass buttons; over it a sleeveless quilted waistcoat of muted brown leather with simple vertical stitching, no flamboyant patterns; under the robe, narrow cream linen trousers tucked into mid-calf dark brown leather boots with slightly pointed toes; at his waist a broad dark maroon cloth sash wrapped twice, knot resting on his left hip with one short tail; the cuffs and collar of the robe are edged with a thin band of dull gold embroidery in a geometric motif inspired by Timurid workshops; he wears a modest signet-style ring on his right hand and small, plain brass stud earrings, no heavy jewellery, projecting a restrained princely practicality.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Kashmiri-Timurid sword with a plain steel blade, a simple cruciform hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, and a wooden scabbard lacquered deep maroon with minimal brass fittings, worn angled at his left hip through the cloth sash and resting visibly at his side.

ref_desc: Young Zain-ul-Abidin has an oval light-brown face, black tied-back hair under a dark indigo turban, a deep forest green robe with brown leather waistcoat, maroon sash, cream trousers, muted brown boots, and a maroon-scabbarded curved sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of young Zain-ul-Abidin: an early-twenties Kashmiri-Timurid prince with an oval light-brown face, sharp brows, straight nose, and a faint scar on his left cheek, eyes calm but calculating. His thick black hair is brushed back and tied low, partially covered by a simple dark indigo turban wound firmly without ornament. He wears a deep forest green jama-like robe, fitted at the torso and flaring to mid-calf, buttoned slightly to the right with small brass buttons and trimmed at collar and cuffs with a thin geometric band of dull gold embroidery. Over this is a sleeveless muted brown quilted leather waistcoat with vertical stitching, and below are narrow cream linen trousers tucked into mid-calf dark brown leather boots with slightly pointed toes. A broad dark maroon cloth sash is wrapped twice around his waist, knotted at the left hip with a short tail, from which hangs his signature weapon: a slightly curved Kashmiri-Timurid sword with a plain steel blade, simple cruciform hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, and a deep maroon wooden scabbard with minimal brass fittings, angled at his left side. Show him in a neutral, balanced stance that suggests both cultured restraint and readiness for decisive action, with clear views of his face, hair, turban, robe, waistcoat, sash, trousers, boots, and sword for consistent redrawing.
